gate_decision.required: macro gain at least 0.01 and no scene regression larger than 0.01
gate_decision.decision: do not expand and do not tune a reliability exponent or threshold

implementation_finding.fix: added a fail-closed query-free validity alignment utility; retained reliability values are byte-preserved and excluded rows are zeroed

interpretation: Separating semantic probability from query-independent primitive precision materially repairs Ramen, so reliability is a real missing state rather than another graph parameter. Linear probability interpolation is slightly non-inferior on Figurines but narrowly misses the frozen macro gate; a probability-theoretic logit power posterior is the only registered follow-up.
